title: Finding the Way
text:
A map shows the streets and places in a city. Maps have a key at the bottom. The key explains the symbols. A blue line on the map is usually a river.

A timetable shows when the bus leaves. Look at the times in the first column. The bus to the park leaves at 9:15. You must be at the stop five minutes before.

questions.text: What does the key on a map explain?
When does the bus to the park leave?
Why should you be at the stop five minutes early?
options: So you do not miss the bus
So you can read the key

questions.text: What can you infer about a blue line on a map?
options: It is probably water, such as a river
It is a road for buses

vocabulary.definition: a list that explains the symbols on a map
a list that shows when buses or trains leave
a vertical list of items in a table

paragraph_translations: Um mapa mostra as ruas e os lugares de uma cidade. Os mapas têm uma legenda na parte de baixo. A legenda explica os símbolos. Uma linha azul no mapa geralmente é um rio.
Um horário mostra quando o ônibus sai. Olhe os horários na primeira coluna. O ônibus para o parque sai às 9:15. Você deve estar no ponto cinco minutos antes.
